claim_boundary: The implementation can learn and exploit peer-dependent structural information when it genuinely determines a synthetic hidden sparse optimum. This says nothing about transformer-layer cooperation.

config.label: SYNTHETIC_MATHEMATICAL_FEASIBILITY_ONLY
config.steps_meaning: meta_training_steps; every arm makes at most one update

decisive_section16_checks.aggregation: paired mean over all declared seeds and budgets; full-support ties at budget 1.0 are retained rather than discarded

disclaimer: SYNTHETIC MATHEMATICAL FEASIBILITY ONLY; NOT EVIDENCE OF REAL-MODEL OR LONG-CONTEXT IMPROVEMENT.

matched_sparse_update_budget_audit.definition: Required sparse arms B--F use identical K and identical one-step parameter-space update L2 for each paired seed and budget.

explicitly_unmatched.oracle_support_update: privileged clean support/update reference; not update-budget-matched

meta_training_audit.definition: Generator feature weights are fit on independent synthetic meta tasks; the held-out evaluation matrix is never used for meta-training.

one_update_protocol_audit.definition: A makes zero updates; B--H each make exactly one update

synthetic_problem_definition.hidden_sparse_optimum: exact TopK of a held-out combination of clean latent structural maps
synthetic_problem_definition.latent: structured low-rank matrix with row/column effects
synthetic_problem_definition.meta_training: feature weights trained on independent generated tasks, never the held-out evaluation matrix
synthetic_problem_definition.observed_gradient: true sparse gradient plus substantial independent coordinate noise
synthetic_problem_definition.optimization: each nonzero arm makes exactly one update
synthetic_problem_definition.peer_maps: element, row, column, and joint structural properties
synthetic_problem_definition.peers: independent noisy same-role observations of the latent matrix
